title: Anvil Quest Forge Tier List: Every Material Ranked

seo.title: Anvil Quest Tier List: Best Forge Materials Ranked (2026)
seo.description: Every forge material in Anvil Quest ranked by how much it actually changes a run, from must-pick S tier down to iron ore, which is exactly as bad as it looks.

excerpt: Ranked by run impact, not raw damage. Iron is F tier and I will not be taking questions.

blocks.text: Ranking forge materials is really ranking the properties they grant, because raw stats are almost irrelevant after floor 4. A material that adds nine damage loses to a material that stops enemies healing. Every time.
Materials, not characters, are the actual ranking target here. The linked character pages cover who benefits most from each material, since the two systems interact heavily.
Why the top tier is what it is

S-tier materials solve a problem you cannot solve any other way. Emberfang's Scale suppresses regeneration. Voidglass ignores shields entirely. Both of these remove an enemy behaviour from the game rather than adding a number to yours, and the back half of Anvil Quest is built almost entirely around those two behaviours.

A-tier materials are strong but replaceable. They add real damage or real survivability, and if you do not have them you can grind a floor or two and compensate. That is the difference: S tier is a key, A tier is a bigger hammer.

Iron Ore is F tier. It grants no property, its stats are outclassed by floor 3, and every beginner guide mentions it first because it is the first thing in the inventory. Copper is C tier purely because chain-hit carries floors 1 through 3 and then becomes dead weight, which is still better than iron's contribution of nothing.

faq.q: What is the best forge material in Anvil Quest?
faq.a: Emberfang's Scale for most builds, because regeneration suppression is required for floors 6 and 7. Voidglass is situationally better against shielded enemies in the endgame.

faq.q: Is iron ore worth collecting in Anvil Quest?
faq.a: No. Iron grants no property and is outclassed by floor 3 materials. The only reason to pick it up is the one-time achievement for forging an iron weapon.

faq.q: How often does this tier list change?
faq.a: The forge system has not been rebalanced since the 2.1 patch in August 2026. If Cold Anvil Studio ships the announced property overhaul, this list gets rewritten from scratch.
